titleEn: How does stress affect the body, and why does exercise help us unwind?
summaryEn:
Stress is often seen as a psychological state, but its effects are entirely real biologically. When the brain perceives danger or pressure, a cascade of nerve and hormonal signals is triggered, changing the heart, muscles, blood vessels and metabolism all at once.

So what really happens in the body when we are stressed, and why does exercise help us feel better?
